title-info.book-title: Tribulation of Myriad Races — Chapter 1630: Mixed blood (1)

section.p: “Die!”
Great Yuan King’s great reputation in combat was not unfounded. He was extremely proficient in combat, and even when he was losing his mind, he could fight well relying on his instincts alone.
After sending Su Yu flying away, Great Yuan King did not give chase. Rather, he took a bow out. Instead of releasing a proper arrow, the bow released an incomparably sharp energy arrow toward Su Yu.
“Who do you think you are?”
“Are you even worthy of becoming the leader of the holy land?”

Countless energy arrows followed behind the first, all shooting straight toward Su Yu. With a roar, Su Yu took his Mark of Civilization out and released countless beasts. The beasts opened their jaws wide and devoured the incoming arrows. The clash created numerous explosions, with the resulting shockwaves spreading in all directions.
The others continued pulling away from the two.

Just as Great Xia King was about to interfere, Su Yu shouted, “I’ll handle this myself! Nobody interfere! I will cut Great Yuan King down with my own hands! Anyone else interferes and I swear the holy guardians will attack humanity today!”
Su Yu continued, “How impudent of him to attack me. I will kill him!”
“Su Yu!” Great Xia King shouted.
Su Yu shouted back, “I will handle this myself. He attacked first. I have the right to defend myself. I will cut him down! Who can say this is wrong?”
“Cutting me down?”

Great Yuan King sneered as he pulled the string of his bow even further back. Instantly, countless arrows flew forward before transforming into humanoid forms. These humanoid figures continued shooting in Su Yu’s direction.
“Su Yu, shameless and arrogant! Today, I’ll cut you down!”

Su Yu snorted and shot forward. Using his palm as a blade, he swung it forward. At the same time, his Mark of Civilization enlarged and sent even more beasts out to interfere with the incoming arrows.
The furious Great Yuan King put his bow away and took a spear out instead…no, that was no spear. It was a massive arrow. Using the arrow as a spear, he shot forward to face Su Yu.
Su Yu continued shooting forward while dodging the arrow attacks. And finally, the palm-blade and the arrow-spear clashed.
The many Invincibles screamed, “Everyone, pull back! Myriad race envoys, don’t go any further or die!”
The auras of numerous Invincibles surged and covered the city.
Silence descended.

The various gathered experts watched in shock. A battle had erupted between Su Yu and Great Yuan King. Was this a spar? Or was this a battle to the death? They were unsure as they weren’t allowed to approach. Was this an act? Or was this a real conflict? But what would be the point of putting up such an act?
Were they trying to create an excuse for Great Yuan King to join a different race as a spy? Or…were they really fighting to the death? Just then, Great Xia King swung his saber at Great Yuan King.
However, Su Yu dispersed the saber qi with a punch and roared, “I said, I’m killing him myself!”
Great Xia King cursed inwardly.
Madness. Absolute madness.
Something must have gone really wrong with Great Yuan King’s tri-life bodies. What was the point of fighting someone who had gone mad head-on?
Was this even worth it?

At the same time, Great Yuan King’s spear was on the verge of stabbing through Su Yu’s head. But when he saw Su Yu stopping the saber attack coming his way, he pulled his spear back and coldly said, “Very well. I will give you this chance. Defeat me today and Great Yuan will serve you from now on. Fail to defeat me and die!”
The spear shot forth again. With a roar, Su Yu used the Time technique and kicked out.
Space around the two shattered as they clashed. In the blink of an eye, hundreds of moves had been exchanged as the two continued fighting each other in close combat.
“Old Zhou…”

When Great Xia King roared anxiously, Great Zhou King sent him a voice transmission, “Wait. Su Yu isn’t weak. Old Yuan might have lost control. Let’s see if he will improve after venting some of his anger. If we stop him right now, it will be too hard for him to return to normal. Su Yu is also losing his mind to anger right now. We should let both of them let off some steam.”

Just then, the two exchanged another move. This time, they weren’t able to keep their power in check and created massive cracks in the ground. The cracks spread further, forcing the surrounding Invincibles to take action.
Alas, the two were too strong.
With a rumble, Liu Wushen was sent flying while coughing blood.
The surrounding people were alarmed.
That was an Invincible!
For many, the battle might seem dreadful, but most couldn’t grasp just how strong the two were. But Liu Wushen’s fate made it clear how serious the battle was.

Elsewhere, the other newly advanced Invincibles took action as well. Among them, only Xia Longwu remained relatively fine. The other Invincibles differed in reaction, but all of them were alarmed by the force of the shockwaves.
Was this the real strength of high-degree Eternals?
With a snort, Su Yu said, “Fight inside the formation. Are you trying to flatten Great Xia?”
“So be it!”
When the two entered the formation, Great Zhou King shouted, “Old Zhu, maintain the formation and prevent the shockwaves from spreading.”

Great Ming King was quite annoyed by that, but he had no choice but to do it. “Everyone, use all your strength and keep the formation operational. Use the sealing power to prevent the shockwaves from spreading!”
They started working together to maintain the formation.
The formation had yet to be completed. Thus, the job was a lot harder than usual. Instantly, shockwaves rippled everywhere inside the formation, destroying one door after another.
Just as Great Zhou King and Great Xia King were about to help, Great Ming King roared, “Stop! You are not familiar enough with the formation to help!”
As the ones producing the formation, it was natural for them to know how to operate it. But people like Great Zhou King would only make their job harder by trying to help.
Just then, a massive explosion erupted.

It was as though two primordial fiends were fighting inside the formation. The two fiends clashed repeatedly, creating one deafening explosion after another. The intensity of the combat and the might they displayed caused many to pale with fright.
Was this Su Yu’s strength? They had only heard of his strength before. This was their first time witnessing him in action. Even a top human expert, Great Yuan King, could only fight him evenly.
Su Yu demonstrated all sorts of techniques as he fought.
Sky Sundering Saber, Time, Heaven Suppressing Fist…

Meanwhile, Great Yuan King only used his spear technique. It was only one technique, but it was not to be underestimated. Each spear strike of his was akin to a roaring dragon, carrying an unstoppable momentum as it shot forward. Each time he managed to push Su Yu away, he would pull his bow out for some ranged attacks.
Great Yuan King might be a warrior, but he was one of the rare ranged warriors. In close combat, he would use his arrow as a spear. The moment distance was gained, he would attack with his bow.
Each of his attacks was incomparably powerful.
Even space and time grew unstable from his attacks.

In the blink of an eye, a patch of nothingness was left at the center of the formation from the intense combat. The shockwaves generated from the combat of two late-degree Eternals were enough to instantly kill fresh Eternals.

Seeing that the battle was still increasing in intensity, Great Ming King roared, “Defend! Old Zhou, Old Xia, erect another formation around the formation! At this rate, these bastards will flatten Great Xia City!”

With a cold expression, Great Xia King swung his saber without saying anything. With each swing of his saber, space was sliced. He was trying to cut space apart to isolate the shockwaves from the rest of the city.
As for Great Zhou King, he released numerous characters. The many characters danced around him like elegant spirits before settling down, forming one formation after another.

They couldn’t interfere in the battle. When two top experts like that were fighting in fury, any interference would be viewed as a provocation. The two lunatics would direct their hostility toward anyone interfering with the battle.
“This is…”

Topsoil Spirit inhaled in shock and said, “This does not seem to be an act. They are fighting for real. Great Yuan King…seems to be losing control over his emotions. Is something wrong with his tri-life bodies?”
Initially, Topsoil Spirit had assumed that this whole thing was an act. But after a while, he noticed that this might be real!
The anger felt too real!

The two combatants were already bleeding all over, but they no longer cared. They were too focused on the battle. In fact, Su Yu was fighting so seriously that death qi was starting to leak from his body.
Clearly, he was starting to use death qi in combat. It definitely wasn’t a good idea to use death qi in the Human Realm.
“Open!”
With a roar, Su Yu opened his Heaven Gate. Instantly, a large amount of death qi surged in his body.
His eyes shone murderously.
“You are courting death. You have successfully angered me!”

With a roar, Su Yu threw another punch. Death qi swept out as the world shook. With a look of alarm, Great Yuan King vanished with a flicker. But at the exact moment, one of the many doors in the formation appeared in his way before exploding. That caused Great Yuan King to stop moving for a split second. Even his River of Time stopped flowing.
With that momentary delay, Su Yu’s punch arrived. Left with no choice, Great Yuan King roared and threw a punch as well.
A massive explosion erupted.
Great Yuan King was sent flying with bleeding arms. At the same time, death qi started spreading all over his body.
Su Yu merely retreated several steps before stabilizing himself. With a sneer, he said, “How can an ant shake a tree?”
